metadata.dateSemantics: Git committer timestamps; no merge commits in the selected window. Baseline is the last reachable commit before start. Current docs fetched after the repository cutoff are technical evidence, not launch dates.
metadata.modelHashSemantics: gitBlobSha1 identifies committed object bytes; it is not a downloaded-file SHA256. No firmware binaries downloaded.
metadata.classificationCaveat: Counts are repository directory/SKU variants, not unique product designs or emulator support. not-established means not proved, not absent.
metadata.classificationMethod: Official product category plus current article/SKU. core, ai_hardware, Atom Voice, StampFly and StackChan count as controller/core-board/host-including kit products. /unit category remains Unit independently of controller chip.
metadata.revisionGroupingMethod: Only terminal vN name labels collapse; kits, pin options, Lite/Adv, S3A and RF variants remain distinct. revisionNameGroup is not a complete product-family count.
